Han et al. — WildGuard: Open One-Stop Moderation Tools for Safety Risks, Jailbreaks, and Refusals of LLMs (2024)

Han and colleagues at the Allen Institute for AI introduce WildGuard, an open seven-billion-parameter moderation model that judges prompt harmfulness, response harmfulness and refusal in one pass, trained on WildGuardMix, a new 92,000-example dataset built to cover adversarial jailbreaks. They report state-of-the-art results among open tools, performance matching and sometimes exceeding GPT-4, and a cut in jailbreak success from 79.8% to 2.4% when it filters a 7B chat model. The Oggy Assessment asks how much of the margin is in-distribution, how firm the ground truth is, and what the result does and does not show for a real-time regulatory layer for AI.
